name: Animazement
blurb: Raleigh's premier Japanese animation and culture convention, an all-volunteer, fan-run event with concerts, panels and cosplay events.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'MAY 28 - 30, 2027' and 'LOCATION Raleigh Convention Center 500 S Salisbury St. Raleigh, NC 27601 DATES May 28 – 30, 2027'
